translations.web: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings.
translations.bsb: This is the fate of the foolish and their followers who endorse their sayings. Selah
translations.kjv: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.
translations.asv: This their way is their folly: Yet after them men approve their sayings. Selah
